summary: In this meeting, a researcher discusses progress on chest X-ray analysis with supervisors. They recap last week's findings regarding the small noise rate gap between ground truth and pseudo labels. To address this, the researcher experimented with two models—a large pre-trained model and a lightweight CNN—to calculate noise rates for different label sets, aiming to refine data quality assessment. 在这次会议中，一名研究人员与导师讨论了胸部X光分析的进展。他们回顾了上周关于真实标签和伪标签之间噪声率差距较小的发现。为了解决这个问题，研究人员尝试了两种模型——一个大型预训练模型和一个轻量级CNN——来计算不同标签集的噪声率，旨在改进数据质量评估。

segments.translation: 例如，在这个数据集中，被标记为“无发现”的类别，我知道人工标注者对它们的标注是不一致的。

segments.speaker: Kamal
segments.content: Because some people have labeled it as this is a completely normal scan and others have labeled it as there is no other finding compared to what these pathology findings are, which means it has pathology, it's just nothing else.
segments.translation: 因为有些人将其标注为这是一个完全正常的扫描，而另一些人则将其标注为与这些病理发现相比没有其他发现，这意味着它确实有病理，只是没有别的发现而已。

segments.speaker: Kamal
segments.content: And that's, you know, that's just how it goes in the real world. You have, you don't have ground truth that's super super accurate and that's why we're looking at this, that's why something like this is valuable.
segments.translation: 你知道，现实世界就是这样。你没有非常非常准确的真实值，这就是我们研究这个的原因，也是为什么像这样的工作很有价值。

segments.speaker: Kamal
segments.content: But yeah, don't be afraid to do things that seem really really simple. That's not a... it's a sign of intelligent way of working, not a sign of like... it's not a sign that you can't do something complicated, it's a sign that you can simplify a complex problem into simple components.
segments.translation: 但是，是的，不要害怕做那些看起来非常非常简单的事情。这并不是……这是一种聪明的这种工作方式的标志，而不是那种……这并不代表你不能做复杂的事情，而是代表你可以把一个复杂的问题简化为简单的组成部分。

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.content: Yeah, I remember what Daniel did was creating simple geometric shapes and then once you get a model that works well on this then you can start scale it on medical images.
segments.translation: 是的，我记得 Daniel 所做的是创建简单的几何形状，一旦你得到了一个在这种形状上运行良好的模型，你就可以开始将其扩展到医学图像上。

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.content: So basically what you want to do is you have a completely clean dataset. You want to look at your... you want to ideally find a model that fits 100% on the completely clean dataset and then add noise to your labels.
segments.translation: 所以基本上你要做的是你有一个完全干净的数据集。你想看看你的……理想情况下你想找到一个在完全干净的数据集上 100% 拟合的模型，然后在你的标签中加入噪声。

segments.speaker: Kamal
segments.content: Given that you have noise in the... that your accuracy will not be a reflection of true accuracy because you have noise. Does that make sense?
segments.translation: 考虑到你在……中存在噪声，你的准确率将不能反映真实的准确率，因为存在噪声。这能理解吗？

segments.speaker: Kamal
segments.content: Do you have more deadlines or is this a cleaner week for you?
segments.translation: 你还有更多的截止日期吗，还是说这周对你来说比较轻松？

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.content: I have a deadline this week. It's one of the courses... Ethics.
segments.translation: 我这周有一个截止日期。是其中一门课……伦理学。

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.content: The idea was to create several years ago was to create a program that's just research, but that's not really possible for masters... So the college sees it as a taught program.
segments.translation: 几年前的想法是创建一个纯研究的项目，但对于硕士来说这不太可能……所以学院将其视为授课型项目。

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.content: It's like this term is the busiest one because we have the elective modules and all of the other modules, but in term three it will be like only this project.
segments.translation: 就像这学期是最忙的一个学期，因为我们有选修模块和其他所有模块，但在第三学期就只有这个项目了。

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.content: Yeah, so term three is... I'll be like focusing on only this project.
segments.translation: 是的，第三学期……我会只专注于这个项目。

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.content: That's good, that's good. Yeah, the other stuff is quite useful as well, like the simulated R&D, that's a useful skill, you know, down the line, or, you know, you're going to have to convince someone at some point to give you funding for something. So that's quite useful. The ethics, my understanding is that these days it's technical ethics, isn't it? Like, you know, technical perspective of ethics, because that course used to be basically philosophy a few years ago. So it's all useful stuff, you know, it's not a waste of time. But yeah, you'll get there once the ethics and that stuff is done, you can then focus on the project.
segments.translation: 很好，很好。是的，其他内容也很有用，比如模拟研发，那是项实用的技能，你知道，以后或者你早晚得在某个时刻说服别人给你提供项目资金。所以这很有用。关于伦理，我的理解是现在的课程讲的是技术伦理，对吧？比如，从技术角度看伦理，因为几年前那门课基本上是哲学课。所以这些都是有用的内容，不是在浪费时间。不过，一旦伦理和那些内容结束，你就能到达那个阶段，然后专注于项目了。

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.content: Okay. I mean, I think you're making progress, but you're coming across challenges that are the challenges I would expect in a real-world research problem. So don't get disheartened because this is not... the results don't haven't proved that you know, you haven't replicated what was in another paper because that's the whole... this is the real experience. You get a paper, it's all beautiful, you try it on for yourself, doesn't it doesn't have the same effect. So this is all perfectly normal. And the way you're going about it is also perfectly normal, you know, taking something that exists, trying it out on your own data, seeing the results for yourself that these are, you know, hard to interpret or you don't know what's going on, and then using that to inform the next step which is to simplify the problem and to start at the toy. So this is completely... this is progress. So I hope you feel that it's positive progress even if the results aren't what you expected.
segments.translation: 好的。我的意思是，我觉得你正在取得进展，但你遇到的挑战正是现实科研问题中我会预料到的挑战。所以不要灰心，因为这并不是……结果没有证明，你知道，你没能复现另一篇论文中的内容，因为这就是……这就是真实的体验。你看一篇论文，写得天花乱坠，你自己动手试一下，却发现效果不一样。所以这完全正常。你处理问题的方式也完全正常，比如拿一个现有的东西，在自己的数据上试运行，亲眼看到这些结果很难解释或者你搞不清楚状况，然后根据这些反馈进行下一步，即简化问题并从简单的模型开始。所以这完全……这就是进展。即便结果不如预期，我还是希望你能感受到这是积极的进展。

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.content: Yeah, definitely.
segments.translation: 是的，确实。

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.content: Okay. Do you have any questions?
segments.translation: 好的。你还有什么问题吗？

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.content: No, it seems pretty clear.
segments.translation: 没有，现在很清楚了。

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.content: Okay. Well, yeah, email us if you if you, you know, if you want to run through what your toy experiment is and what you think it should be, send that in an email, that's fine.
segments.translation: 好的。嗯，如果你想梳理一下你的初步实验是什么以及你认为应该是什么样的，发邮件告诉我们就行，没问题。

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.content: Anything else we should talk about, either side?
segments.translation: 两边还有什么要讨论的吗？

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.content: Don't think so.
segments.translation: 我觉得没有了。

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.content: Yeah, just go through just go through that short paper and that'll give you some suggestions on what you could start doing.
segments.translation: 是的，仔细读读那篇短论文，它会给你一些建议，告诉你从哪里开始着手。

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.content: Okay. Yeah. Thank you.
segments.translation: 好的。是的。谢谢。

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.content: And then Carmody, do you have two minutes? Just to talk about the email I sent you yesterday.
segments.translation: 然后 Carmody，你有两分钟时间吗？我想谈谈昨天发给你的那封邮件。

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.content: Yeah, okay. Yeah. Brilliant.
segments.translation: 好的，没问题。太棒了。

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.content: Okay. Thank you. Thank you, everyone.
segments.translation: 好的。谢谢。谢谢大家。

segments.content: See you. Thanks. Bye.
segments.translation: 再见。谢谢。拜拜。
